exposure: Surgical sterilization procedures (postpartum tubal ligation, laparoscopic tubal disruption or salpingectomy, hysteroscopic tubal occlusion)
outcome: Damages for wrongful conception, negligence, and wrongful birth
cohort: Six women who underwent surgical sterilization and subsequently became subjects of civil proceedings concerning negligence or wrongful outcomes.
finding: Women who underwent negligently performed sterilization were entitled to recover damages for wrongful conception, negligence, and wrongful birth, and some sterilization techniques may present a greater risk of failure, exposing surgeons to malpractice litigation.
